title: EnTurbo: Accelerate Confidential Serverless Computing via Parallelizing Enclave Startup Procedure
problem: Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) startup procedures introduce significant performance overhead in confidential serverless workloads. The sequential enclave initialization process creates a critical bottleneck that degrades latency for serverless functions.
motivation: Serverless computing requires balancing privacy guarantees through TEEs with practical performance requirements for wide adoption.
method: Enclave startup normally must complete each initialization step before starting the next, creating a bottleneck. EnTurbo identifies which steps don't depend on each other and runs those independent steps at the same time using multiple threads. It maintains provable security (mathematical proof that running steps in parallel stays safe), so it gets faster startup without sacrificing safety.
key_novelty: Enclave startup is parallelized—multiple independent initialization steps run at the same time instead of one after another—through provable security.
contributions: Parallelized enclave startup procedure eliminating sequential integrity dependencies
Multi-threaded measurement mechanism with formal security guarantees
1.42x-6.48x speedup on SGXv1 and 1.33x-3.76x speedup on SGXv2 for confidential serverless workloads
